prompt.zh-TW: 下列哪一種情況會讓負債比率顯示 N/A，而不是 0？
prompt.en: In which of these situations would the debt ratio show N/A rather than 0?

text.zh-TW: 公司還在籌備，股款尚未繳入，資產總計是零
text.en: The company is still being set up and no capital has been paid in, so total assets are zero

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。負債比率的分母是資產總計，分母為零就沒有定義，顯示 N/A。
feedback.en: That’s right. The denominator of the debt ratio is total assets; with a zero denominator the ratio is undefined and shows N/A.

text.zh-TW: 公司完全沒有負債，負債總額是零
text.en: The company has no liabilities at all, so total liabilities are zero

feedback.zh-TW: 沒有負債確實很特別，你注意到這一點很好。不過分子為零、分母存在時比率算得出來，結果是零，不是 N/A。
feedback.en: Having no liabilities is unusual, and it is good that you noticed. But with a zero numerator and an existing denominator the ratio can be calculated: the result is zero, not N/A.

text.zh-TW: 公司今年發生虧損，股東權益跟著變少
text.en: The company made a loss this year, so its equity has shrunk

feedback.zh-TW: 虧損確實會影響報表，這個直覺沒錯：它透過未分配盈餘讓股東權益變小，負債比率的數字通常會上升。不過分母的資產總計還在，比率仍然算得出來，不會變成 N/A。
feedback.en: A loss does affect the statements, so the instinct is reasonable: it shrinks equity through retained earnings, and the debt ratio usually rises. But total assets, the denominator, are still there, so the ratio can still be calculated and does not become N/A.

explanation.zh-TW: N/A 來自分母為零。{{term:tm_9e1rb64c}}的分母是{{term:tm_t7a3s6wb}}，所以只有{{option:o_q315}}會 N/A；{{option:o_61tx}}是分子為零、結果為 0；{{option:o_be7q}}不會讓這個比率算不出來（虧損讓權益變小，負債比率通常反而上升）。
explanation.en: N/A comes from a zero denominator. The denominator of the {{term:tm_9e1rb64c}} is {{term:tm_t7a3s6wb}}, so only {{option:o_q315}} gives N/A; {{option:o_61tx}} is a zero numerator, giving 0; and {{option:o_be7q}} does not stop the ratio being calculated (a loss shrinks equity, so the debt ratio usually rises).
